checks: Dry run validates and reports deduplicated results without creating files or directories
Append imports unique content, retains the other pool/settings, and backs up the original list
Repeated identical import is idempotent and creates no extra files or backups
Later imports preserve existing audio registrations and back up the prior manifest
Replace and Disconnected modes change only the selected pool and retain imported files
Invalid media headers fail before changing the target
Unmanaged manifests are preserved and rejected
Conflicting imported filenames cannot overwrite existing content
The 128-recording pool limit is enforced before writes
Writes to a running game are blocked while DryRun remains read-only
PowerShell syntax passes and atomic commit leaves no temporary files
